description: PiWallet Pass v1 challenge vectors. text is joined with \n and has no trailing newline; the challenge is SHA-256 of its UTF-8 bytes. request.wallet is the fingerprint, or empty when the request names no wallet.

vectors.name: sign-in with a named wallet
vectors.text:
piwallet-pass:v1
origin:https://shop.example
id:q7ZtR2vXkY0aB9cD
purpose:sign-in
mode:get
nonce:AAECAwQFBgcICQoLDA0ODxAREhMUFRYXGBkaGxwdHh8
wallet:cf987d8c

vectors.name: create with no wallet named
vectors.text:
piwallet-pass:v1
origin:https://dev.piwalletpay.com
id:signup-0001
purpose:create-account
mode:create
nonce:__79_Pv6-fj39vX08_Lx8O_u7ezr6uno5-bl5OPi4eA
wallet:

vectors.name: origin with a port
vectors.text:
piwallet-pass:v1
origin:https://localhost:8443
id:A_b-9xyz
purpose:confirm
mode:get
nonce:AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
wallet:00000000

wallet_proof.description: walletProof = base64url(HMAC-SHA256(key, "piwallet-pass:v1:wallet-proof\n" || challenge)). key is bytes 13..78 of the base58check-decoded xpub (chain code, then compressed public key). The xpub is the BIP32 test vector 1 master key.
